name: aurum-web-assets
description: The client's non-Rust assets: the stylesheet Tailwind builds, the service worker, and the Pdfium engine the sheet renderer drives.

scripts.pdfium: mkdir -p build/pdfium && cp node_modules/@hyzyla/pdfium/dist/index.esm.browser.js build/pdfium/pdfium.js && cp node_modules/@hyzyla/pdfium/dist/pdfium.wasm build/pdfium/pdfium.wasm && cp node_modules/@hyzyla/pdfium/LICENSE.md build/pdfium/LICENSE.md
